film: this wallet put eighteen thousand four hundred dollars into memes.
today those memes are worth thirty five cents.
the same dollars in nvda would be worth almost seventeen thousand.
each buy priced at its own chainlink round. measured, not estimated.
this is terra firma. a router keeps a slice of every meme trade as stock.
a jar holds it. fees burn wif and pay stakers. all real, on mainnet.
first i buy a meme. no slice.
one confirmation, through uniswap. forty one wallet in.
my card: one dollar in, sixty cents now. in nvda, still a dollar.
this meme is going nowhere. so i convert it.
two signatures. the meme is sold, and real nvda lands in my jar.
my jar. a dollar twenty five of real stock tokens. no admin key, i withdraw any time.
but you don't have to stop trading memes. you just keep a slice.
two percent of this buy lands in my jar as nvda. same transaction.
selling works the same way. two pons out, with a slice to the jar.
every trade pays a half percent fee. that's where wif comes in.
i buy wif. terra firma only ever buys wif. it never sells it.
then i stake it to nvda. stake ten thousand and your fee drops to point three percent.
a hundred wif, activating next epoch.
each epoch, the fee pool splits. anyone can run it.
half buys wif and burns it. eleven point three six burned this epoch.
the other half buys stock for stakers.
claimed, straight into my jar as nvda.
last, i mint my card. the contract recomputes it from chainlink,
then burns one wif. minted onchain.
it hits the leaderboard. biggest regrets, biggest jars.
don't trust me. every number is read from the chain, and any card can be recomputed onchain.
it's for meme traders on robinhood chain, and wif holders paid in stock.
tracked memes only. not profit and loss. unaudited, so keep it small.
that's terra firma. stand on wif. sweep the rest into stock.
